summary: The third session of test fixes worked the one row left, AC-ITEM-01 (high risk). A new test drives a real run with development delivery on to the hold stop, where every commit was confirmed delivered early, and shows that Continue anyway completes the run with no pull request session. The waiver test now builds a phase after Continue anyway, so the feature head moves, and the waived item keeps its waiver. Each test was seen to fail against a break of the behavior it proves. A fresh re-grader put AC-ITEM-01 at Adequate, with 20 of 20 stated parts covered, so every criterion is now Adequate or better and test-audit.md reads Done. Only tests changed. Unit and package suites passed. The integration suite had one failure, a takeover-history browser test unrelated to these criteria, which passed when re-run on its own.
